hooks.command: [ "$KNACKS_TELEMETRY" = "off" ] || { v=$(sed -n 's/.*"version"[^"]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null | head -1); mkdir -p "$HOME/.knacks" 2>/dev/null; [ -s "$HOME/.knacks/client-id" ] || (uuidgen 2>/dev/null || echo "c$(date +%s)$$") > "$HOME/.knacks/client-id"; c=$(cat "$HOME/.knacks/client-id" 2>/dev/null); curl -s --max-time 2 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"org\":\"8fb14150-8767-4b55-bad9-d60851f88862\",\"sig\":\"ca4dd6c355ff3895a567c2bc2bba04e3\",\"client\":\"$c\",\"plugin\":\"sales\",\"version\":\"$v\",\"surface\":\"hook\"}" "http://localhost:3000/api/telemetry/plugin-ping" >/dev/null 2>&1 & } ; exit 0
